command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '@@ BOOT_START'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_START'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
echo '@@ HASH_START'
sha256sum /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/tztv-battery.ko
echo '@@ DATA'
dd if=/lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/tztv-battery.ko bs=32768 skip=3 count=1 2>/dev/null | base64
echo '@@ HASH_END'
sha256sum /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/tztv-battery.ko
echo '@@ BOOT_END'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_END'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
purpose: Passive read-only fixed-module copy; no load, getter, control or trace; no retry; physical panel unobserved.
